d: India is stepping up its push for Russia-Ukraine peace with a proposal to reopen the Black Sea shipping route. As trilateral talks between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. resume in Abu Dhabi, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has discussed the initiative with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. The plan aims to restore grain exports and protect global food supplies. Can India's proposal help bring the two sides closer to peace? Palki Sharma tells you.
